Jordan (Client Infosec):
Hey all, for the upcoming POC we need detailed audit evidence: per-request metadata (caller, timestamp, model id, status), daily integrity proofs, and an access pattern showing the temporary API key lifecycle. Can you support for a 10-day eval?

Tara (AE):
Yes. We have two delivery patterns: push-to-SIEM (syslog/HEC) or signed daily exports to an S3 bucket. Which works best for you?

Jordan (Client Infosec):
Signed S3 exports preferred. Our policy requires SHA256 digests and the kms key used to sign manifests. Also need retention proof for 90 days and the audit trail for key creation/deletion.

Sam (SE):
We can do that. For POCs we issue a time-limited "telemetry" API key with tight scopes + optional IP lock. Everything we do (create key, delete key, change scope) is recorded in our platform audit stream which is included in the daily export.

Nico (Compliance):
Couple items: 1) Hosted tenants default redact request bodies. If you need full request/response we require a signed Data Access Addendum (DAA). 2) Proofs must show manifest signature and KMS key id.

Jordan (Client Infosec):
We only need metadata (no payload) for now. Please show an example manifest and explain how to verify the signature.

Sam (SE):
Example manifest we put next to the export prefix: redwood-exports/YYYY-MM-DD/manifest.json. It contains file list, sha256 digests, signed_by_kms_key and platform_signature. Sample below:

```
{
  "date":"2026-03-03",
  "files":["audit-2026-03-03.ndjson.gz","platform-audit-2026-03-03.log.gz"],
  "digests":{"audit-2026-03-03.ndjson.gz":"e3b0c44298fc1c149..."},
  "signed_by_kms_key":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999988887777:key/abcd-1234",
  "platform_signature":"base64-signature",
  "retention_days":"90"
}
```

Verification steps: we sign the manifest with our KMS key and include the key ARN. Customer can fetch the manifest and verify the signature with the public cert we provide (or by checking the KMS key ID and our attestation bundle).

Jordan (Client Infosec):
OK. For the S3 put we need the principal and prefix. We'll provide role arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/AcmeRedwoodIngest and bucket arn:aws:s3:::acme-poc-logs with prefix redwood/; SSE-KMS enabled.

Sam (SE):
Please confirm the exact prefix and whether the role has kms:Encrypt permission for your bucket key. We'll set up the export job and run a small test put. Also: if you want the API key IP-locked, give us the CIDR.

Jordan (Client Infosec):
Prefix: redwood/; role already has PutObject + kms:Encrypt. IP to lock: 198.51.100.22/32.

devops-bot:
Provisioning export job: job_id ej-92ab, destination s3://acme-poc-logs/redwood/, schedule daily UTC 00:10, manifest_signed_by arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999988887777:key/abcd-1234.

Sam (SE):
I'll issue a scoped API key: policy will include ["audit:read","models:usage:read"], expiry 10d, ip_restrict 198.51.100.22/32. Example policy snippet: 

```
{"scope":["audit:read","models:usage:read"],"expiry":"240h","ip_restrict":"198.51.100.22/32","resources":["org:acme","project:poc"]}
```

We will DM the token to Jordan once created.

devops-bot:
Token created: tk-81f4b2, created_at 1843712009, expires_at 1844612009, ip_lock 198.51.100.22/32. Creation event logged to platform-audit stream.

Nico (Compliance):
Please ensure the daily manifest includes a deletion record for the token after expiry. We will want to see creation + deletion timestamps in the exported audit.

Sam (SE):
Confirmed: deletion events are emitted and included in platform-audit-*.log.gz inside the export. We also keep an internal proof bundle for 180 days for enterprise customers; for POC we mirror 90 days as requested.

Jordan (Client Infosec):
Good. Final ask: can you supply a short evidence packet for the SOC reviewer before the sync tomorrow? Something like: sample manifest, single-day export (sanitized), token creation/deletion events.

Tara (AE):
Yes, we'll prepare a redacted sample export + manifest and the event logs. Sam will DM the token to Jordan. I'll book the 30m review tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Jordan (Client Infosec):
Thanks all. Please avoid sending any request bodies in the sample export. If we need full payloads later we'll sign the DAA. See you on the call. :thumbsup:
